import networkx as nx

n = 15
center = 0
rim = list(range(1, n))
edges = [(center, i) for i in rim]

# Check vertex connectivity

# Check minimum degree

from itertools import combinations

    H.remove_nodes_from(combo)
    if not nx.is_connected(H):
